description:
Sonatype is the company helping enterprises build with confidence in the AI era. Trusted by thousands of enterprises and millions of developers, Sonatype gives organizations the intelligence and automated governance to manage the open source, AI-generated, and third-party components that power modern software.
 
As the steward of Maven Central and the company behind Nexus Repository, Sonatype provides visibility into how software is built, consumed, and secured, helping teams accelerate development, reduce risk, and deliver secure software at AI scale. To learn more about Sonatype, please visit www.sonatype.com.

You will join our dynamic APAC Solutions Engineering team based in Singapore, acting as the technical backbone of our commercial growth across the region. We are a collaborative, high-energy group of builders, security enthusiasts, and problem-solvers who partner closely with Account Executives, Product Management, and Customer Success to help enterprises modernize their DevSecOps practices.

The Opportunity

As an Associate Sales Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of modern software development, cybersecurity, and business impact. You will learn the craft of enterprise pre-sales while putting your passion for DevOps and security into action every day. In this role, you will:

  • Partner with Senior Sales Engineers and Account Executives to run technical discovery sessions and uncover software supply chain risks for prospective customers across Singapore and APAC.

  • Deliver tailored, high-impact demonstrations of the Sonatype Platform (including Nexus Repository, Sonatype Lifecycle, and SBOM management) to developers, DevOps engineers, and security leaders.

  • Support and co-lead technical Proof of Value (PoV) evaluations, integrating Sonatype tools into customer CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.

  • Answer technical security questionnaires, RFIs, and RFPs with precision and clarity.

  • Stay ahead of emerging DevSecOps trends, open-source threat intelligence, and cloud-native tooling, sharing insights back with the broader team and our customers.

    •  

    What You Bring to the Table

  • A genuine passion for DevOps and Security: You love understanding how software is built, shipped, and secured, and you are excited by the challenge of stopping malicious open-source components before they reach production.

  • Foundational technical fluency: Hands-on exposure (through coursework, personal projects, internships, or 1–2 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, IT, or technical support) with modern SDLC concepts and CI/CD tools (such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps).

  • Coding or scripting curiosity: Working familiarity with at least one language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, or Bash) and an understanding of package managers (Maven, npm, PyPI, NuGet).

  • Clear, empathetic communication: The ability to listen actively, ask sharp questions, and translate technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Growth mindset & adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced environment, welcome constructive feedback, and are eager to master enterprise technical sales.

  • Location: Based in Singapore with the right to work locally and willingness to collaborate across APAC time zones.

    • It Would Be Phenomenal If You Also Had

  • Exposure to application security (AppSec), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), or Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) frameworks.

  • Familiarity with containers and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, or infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible).

  • Prior customer-facing experience in a technical support, consulting, or associate pre-sales capacity.
